hyperparameters.iteration_accounting: 2333 cumulative L-BFGS iterations from zero initialization: 40, then 195 in 15-iteration chunks, then 400, 800, and 898. Limited-memory history was reset between those segments. The last segment stopped because the tolerance was met.
